hitbox_priority.tooling_correction: An earlier read of CShapeRaycaster.Raycast with tools/recon_disasm.py produced two false string annotations ("Basketball_Net_1", "Dunk") on two `ldr x9,[x8,#0x258]` / `ldr x1,[x8,#0x260]` instructions. Root cause: the script tracked `pages[reg]` (adrp page base) per register but never invalidated it when that register was later overwritten by something other than adrp (here, `ldr x8,[x0]` reusing x8 for a vtable pointer). Fixed in tools/recon_disasm.py by clearing pages[dst] on every ldr destination; re-run confirms both instructions are the ordinary vtable slot-18 (get_eventCamera) dispatch, not string/GOT references. No other doc in this repo was produced with the unfixed tool as far as checked in this pass; flagging this as a correction, not a finding about basketball naming.
